capabilities: sync Google contacts into per-contact notes
audit vault notes for contacts missing in Google
customize note templates, folders, and filename naming
choose frontmatter naming strategies including vCard compatibility
render contact relations as Obsidian links
extras: Setup requires creating a Google Cloud project, enabling the People API, configuring an OAuth consent screen, and adding yourself as a test user; sync updates only contact frontmatter and never overwrites user text or custom properties.
intentEvidence: Synchronize your Google contacts directly into Obsidian! Each contact becomes a separate note with YAML frontmatter
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull contacts from a Google account into notes or keep that contact data up to date.

relations.evidence: VCF (vCard): Fully compatible with the VCF Contacts plugin.

requires.name: Google account with People API access
Google OAuth Client ID and Client Secret

summary: Syncs Google Contacts into the vault as one note per contact with YAML frontmatter, preserving user edits, with label filtering and an orphaned-contact audit.
